lines: The city lights shining down, lively laughter and footprints in the back alley
How much of the longing I wanted to share ever reached you? I always turn around to check
Because you, never hesitating, would surely chase after any version of me
The me reflected in the eyes I gazed into so intently — the mark that I lived
A heartbeat that kept nearly fading, ringing out strong, so strong — I want to try getting past today
Rather than standing frozen, afraid of losing the happiness I hold in my hands
I scheme to make smiles bloom, one by one, as many as I can, each one bigger
I remember — so that the days we passed through will always look radiant to us
In the warmth of you, held tight in my hand, I felt it — the proof that we were connected
Right now, at the same pace as you, I'm walking through the future we drew that day
No matter how many wishes come true, I want to spend a new tomorrow with you, right away
One after another, I know I'll just go on wishing again
Because the flowing time will mercilessly sweep us away someday
So that in the instant of a single blink, I don't miss anything you show me
The me reflected in the eyes I gazed into so intently — the mark that I lived
A heartbeat that kept nearly fading, ringing out strong, so strong
Even if I can't get past today
I won't forget the today I lived with you
